Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 41

“Therefore, best of the Bharatas, first restrain the senses and strike down this destroyer of knowledge and discrimination.”

The order of operations matters — senses first, the outermost position. Krishna gives Arjuna somewhere to begin rather than asking him to defeat desire everywhere at once.
